steps.title: Bridge to Life
body: Let’s look together at the way of life God has prepared for you. Read or listen one step at a time.

verses.text: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.”

steps.title: God wants you to have abundant life
body: What is most precious in your life? Gaining the whole world means nothing if you lose your life.
God created people out of love, and He planned for us to enjoy an abundant, eternal life with Him.
So why do so many people live with emptiness instead of this life?

verses.text: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his soul?
I came that they may have life and have it abundantly.

steps.title: Sin has separated us from God
body: God is holy and righteous. But people have turned away from God and lived their own way.
The Bible calls this sin. Sin is going against God’s will in our thoughts, words and actions.
As a result, a deep gap now lies between God and people.

verses.text: For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.

steps.title: The result of sin is death and judgment
body: The price of sin is death: being separated forever from God, the source of life.
Every person dies once, and after that faces judgment before God.
This is the most important question in life, and no one can avoid it.

verses.text: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
And just as it is appointed for man to die once, and after that comes judgment.

steps.title: Human effort cannot cross the gap
body: Many people try to cross this gap through good deeds, morality, religion or education.
These efforts have value, but they fall far short of reaching a holy God.
Salvation is not earned by what we do. It is a free gift from God.

verses.text: We have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteous deeds are like a polluted garment.
For by grace you have been saved through faith. And this is not your own doing; it is the gift of God, not a result of works, so that no one may boast.

steps.title: God built the bridge through Jesus Christ
body: God loved us so much that He sent His Son, Jesus Christ, into the world.
Jesus, who had no sin, took our sins upon Himself and died on the cross. He was buried, and on the third day He rose again.
The cross of Jesus is the only bridge to God.

verses.text: But God shows his love for us in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
Christ died for our sins in accordance with the Scriptures, that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day in accordance with the Scriptures.

steps.title: Believe and receive Jesus, and you will have life
body: A bridge does no good unless you cross it.
Faith is more than knowing about Jesus. It means receiving Him as your Savior and Lord and trusting Him with your life.
Whoever believes in Jesus does not come into judgment, but has passed from death to life.

verses.text: But to all who did receive him, who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God.
Truly, truly, I say to you, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life. He does not come into judgment, but has passed from death to life.

steps.title: Will you receive Jesus into your heart now?
body: Jesus is knocking on the door of your heart even now.
The prayer below is only an example. What matters is not the exact words but a sincere heart. If this prayer expresses your heart, pray it to God now.

verses.text: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and eat with him, and he with me.

steps.prayer: Father God, I admit that I am a sinner and cannot come to You on my own. I believe that Jesus died on the cross for my sins and rose again. Right now I receive Jesus into my heart as my Savior and Lord. Thank You for forgiving my sins and making me Your child. Please lead my life from now on. In Jesus’ name I pray. Amen.

steps.title: To you, now a child of God
body: Everyone who has received Jesus has eternal life. This assurance rests not on feelings but on God’s unchanging promise.

verses.text: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life. I write these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life.

list: Talk with God in prayer every day.
Read the Bible every day. Start with the Gospel of John.
Join a church and worship with your family of faith.
Share this good news with others.
